databaseHygieneInventory.backupRequirement: Backup/snapshot must be created manually in MongoDB Atlas before cleanup.

issues.before: defaultOrigins in env.js omitted https://varanasiyatra.com and https://www.varanasiyatra.com, potentially blocking production domain traffic unless ALLOWED_ORIGINS was supplied.
issues.after: productionDomainOrigins explicitly includes https://varanasiyatra.com, https://www.varanasiyatra.com, https://admin.varanasiyatra.com, and Vercel domains. Localhost/dev origins excluded in production. Wildcard origins forbidden.
issues.productionImpact: Official domain requests are guaranteed to be accepted across web and API.

issues.before: Active MongoDB cluster contained test enquiries, test users, test vendors, and test bookings generated during testing.
issues.after: Created scripts/production-data-inventory.cjs with multi-signal classification. Created scripts/production-data-cleanup.cjs defaulting strictly to --dry-run (0 deletions). Only CLEAR_TEST eligible upon explicit flags and backup confirmation.
issues.evidence: Inventory scanned 404 records: 178 CLEAR_TEST, 18 LIKELY_TEST, 2 UNKNOWN, 206 REAL_DATA. Dry run cleanup confirmed 0 deleted records.
issues.productionImpact: Safe operational tooling in place. Contamination isolated without data loss risk.
issues.remainingAction: Create manual snapshot in MongoDB Atlas, then run fresh production DB or execute guarded cleanup.

issues.before: Potential ambiguity between localhost dev URL and Cloud Run instance.
issues.after: src/constants/crm.js guarantees import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL takes absolute precedence. .env.production includes Cloud Run backend fallback. Localhost behavior cleanly isolated to local browser development.
issues.productionImpact: Production builds reliably connect to designated API URL.
issues.remainingAction: Inject VITE_API_BASE_URL in Vercel project environment settings if routing to custom domain API.

issues.before: loginLimiter set to permissive 500 requests / 15 minutes.
issues.after: Reduced loginLimiter to 20 attempts / 15 minutes per IP in production (NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 20 : 500).
issues.productionImpact: Thwarts credential stuffing while allowing normal CEO and Manager login flows.

issues.before: initializeUsers() defaulted to hardcoded fallback passwords if CEO_INITIAL_PASSWORD or MANAGER_INITIAL_PASSWORD were unset.
issues.after: In production (NODE_ENV === 'production'), CEO_INITIAL_PASSWORD and MANAGER_INITIAL_PASSWORD are required; startup aborts with code 1 if missing. No predictable fallback passwords permitted in production. Passwords are never logged.
issues.evidence: backend/config/env.js:48-53; backend/server.js:279-284; backend/functions/index.js:279-284; test-production-readiness-hardening.cjs Test 5 PASS
issues.productionImpact: Guarantees production instances cannot boot with predictable default credentials.
issues.remainingAction: Ensure secure random initial passwords are supplied in production environment secrets.

issues.before: Express lacked a centralized 4-parameter error handler middleware, risking uncaught error HTML / stack trace leak.
issues.after: Centralized Express error handler added to backend/server.js and backend/functions/index.js. Returns standard JSON { success: false, message: ... }. Stack traces and database internals stripped in production.
issues.productionImpact: Consistent, leak-free error responses across all routes.

issues.before: firebase-tools was in dependencies in backend/package.json, pulling heavy dev-server packages into runtime container.
issues.after: Moved firebase-tools from dependencies to devDependencies in backend/package.json. Verified zero runtime code imports.
issues.productionImpact: Leaner container image, smaller attack surface, faster cold starts.

issues.before: Local mongodump tool not installed in environment; snapshot mechanism could fail silently.
issues.after: Strict procedural mandate: 'Backup/snapshot must be created manually in MongoDB Atlas before cleanup.' Programmatic mock snapshot forbidden.
issues.productionImpact: Zero risk of irreversible production data loss.
issues.remainingAction: Admin logs into MongoDB Atlas Cloud UI -> Clusters -> Backup -> Take Snapshot.

issues.before: Password recovery generated tokens without clear status indicator of outbound delivery.
issues.after: Clearly declares deliveryStatus: 'SMTP_NOT_CONFIGURED'. Reset tokens are never logged to console and never returned in response payload during production.
issues.productionImpact: Clear visibility into email delivery readiness; zero token leakage.
issues.remainingAction: Configure real transactional SMTP (e.g. SendGrid, Postmark, AWS SES) when ready to enable emails.

issues.before: Frontend stores access and refresh tokens in browser localStorage.
issues.after: Documented and classified as MEDIUM / FUTURE HARDENING. Preserved existing working authentication architecture to avoid breaking login.
issues.evidence: Architecture review; no breaking cookie overhaul in this phase
issues.productionImpact: Login remains reliable; future phase can introduce httpOnly cookies with CSRF tokens.

issues.before: Helmet is enabled without strict CSP directives.
issues.after: Evaluated and classified as FOLLOW-UP HARDENING. Blindly enabling strict CSP now risks breaking external resources (Google Maps, Leaflet tiles, Google Fonts, PWA icons, Vercel analytics).
issues.evidence: Helmet configuration review; frontend external font & tile dependencies
issues.productionImpact: Prevents catastrophic resource breakage upon deployment.
issues.remainingAction: Formulate exact CSP domain allowlist during post-launch hardening.

issues.before: /admin/enquiries aggregates multiple booking collections in memory before pagination.
issues.after: Documented and classified as FUTURE SCALE OPTIMIZATION. Preserved existing aggregation to prevent breaking CRM query semantics.
issues.evidence: backend/server.js:1060-1120; all 24 CRM draft safety tests pass
issues.productionImpact: Current dataset (~400 records) handles aggregation in under 100ms. Optimization needed at >10,000 active records.
issues.remainingAction: Implement MongoDB $facet / native pipeline aggregation in future scale sprint.

issues.before: Potential cross-contamination between local developer mock habits and production behavior.
issues.after: Verified complete separation: NODE_ENV switches CORS allowlists, disables dev origins, mandates initial passwords, hides error stack traces, enforces 20 req/15min rate limits, and suppresses reset token leakage.
issues.productionImpact: Zero mock login, test seed, or bypass behavior can execute in production.
issues.remainingAction: Ensure NODE_ENV=production is injected in production hosting.
